{{Top}}
[[File:Cinnagar_Overflow_Courtroom_4_FotSE2.png|thumb|right|250px|A judge reads the charges against [[Jori Daragon]] in [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]] [[Overflow Courtroom 4]].]]
{{Quote|I doubt this will come as a surprise to the Jedi, Master Sebatyne, but there ''are'' a few weak-minded judges serving the Galactic Alliance.''"<br />"''There ''are''? This one ''is'' outraged!|[[Natasi Daala]] and [[Saba Sebatyne]], referring to [[Arabelle Lorteli]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
A '''judge''' was a legal worker, usually government-appointed, who presided over legal cases. Examples included [[Mavari Zudan]], a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] judge in the service of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

Some judges, especially found on back-[[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]], were corrupt and could be bribed.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

Judges were also used in sporting contests to adjudicate the competition between at least two parties. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Unidentified googly-eyed species|googly-eyed aliens]] misinterpreted a [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]] between an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Rebel Alliance corvette)|Star Destroyer]] and an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Unidentified Alliance corvette|corvette]] as a sporting contest. Appalled at the mismatch between them, the aliens [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] the two crews and brought them aboard their [[fathership]] to continue their contest. The aliens graciously offered to serve as judges.<ref name="Night">{{WEGCite|story=The Night Has a Thousand Eyes|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
